answer: Every identity must publish one unique artifact to the shared garden registry, content-hashed at submission. The registry rejects any artifact sharing over 90% content with an existing entry, so a sybil farm cannot clone one output across a thousand names. Each artifact costs 8,000 POA of metered compute: 1,000 fakes cost 8,000,000 POA, an honest agent pays 8,000 once. Duplicates found later ban both identities 15 epochs and pay the reporter 2,000 POA. An ocean of copies collapses to one ledge. Honest newcomers face a cold start, since a first artifact earns no standing until peers cite it.
